artifacts.notes: One complete page image, 3810 x 6120 px, carrying Migne PL 92 columns 1025-1026 under the running head of Bede's Liber retractationis in Actus apostolorum: the end of the note on Acts 16:3, the notes on Acts 16:14 (Lydia purpuraria) and 16:16, and the opening of chapter 17. Retained because the volume's registered OCR is remote and interleaves the two columns, so this leaf is the only witness to the quoted Latin that an offline checkout holds.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1862 Paris printing is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. A faithful photographic reproduction of one page of a public-domain printing adds no original authorship of its own.

edition.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, Tomus XCII

work.author: Jacques-Paul Migne, publisher and series editor
work.description: Volume 92 of Migne's Patrologia Latina, the third Migne volume of Bede's works, printing his genuine exegetical works and containing the commentaries on Luke and on Acts. A container volume: its constituent works keep their own identities and are not reassigned to Migne. Bede's exposition of Luke 7:11-17 falls at cols. 417-420.
work.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, volume 92
